biotools.summary: FluSurver is a web-based tool for analyzing influenza virus sequences, particularly for determining antiviral resistance and characterizing genetic variations. It leverages sequence data and phylogenetic analysis to provide insights into influenza evolution and potential mismatches with vaccine strains.
